content.title: Which grocery stores are open on Easter? See the list in Massachusetts
content.text: April 5, 2026, 5:02 a.m. ETNeed to to make a last-minute trip to the supermarket on Easter? Many Massachusetts grocery stores will be open on Easter Sunday, but their hours may be limited.While no state laws prevent supermarkets from opening as usual on Easter, many opt to open with limited hours to allow employees to celebrate the holiday.To avoid any surprises, shoppers should check store hours before heading out to the supermarket on Sunday, April 5.Here's what to know about popular Massachusetts grocery stores on the spring holiday.Is Stop & Shop open on Easter 2026?Most Massachusetts Stop & Shop stores will be open until 5 p.m. on Easter Sunday, the website said.Is Market Basket open on Easter 2026?All Market Basket stores, including the ones in Somerville, Burlington, and Brockton, will be closed on Easter Sunday.Is Shaw's/Star Market open on Easter 2026?Most Shaw's and Star Market locations will be open regular business hours on Easter Sunday.Is Big Y open on Easter 2026?Big Y grocery stores will be closed on Sunday, April 5, according to the chain's website.Is Roche Bros. open on Easter 2026?Roche Bros. stores will be closed on Easter Sunday this year, according to the company's website.Is ALDI open on Easter 2026?ALDI locations will be closed on Easter Sunday, including the Brockton, Falmouth, Springfield, Worcester, and Medford stores, according to the chain's website.Is Price Rite open on Easter 2026?Most Price Rite stores in Massachusetts will be open from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. on April 5, according to a company spokesperson.However, both Worcester locations, the New Bedford store, the south New Bedford store, the Fall River store, the Hyde Park store, the Seekonk store, and the Lynn store will be open from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.The West Springfield store will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.Is Hannaford open on Easter 2026?Most Hannaford locations in Massachusetts will be open until 3 p.m. on Sunday, April 5, according to the supermarket chain's website. This includes the Middleboro, Waltham, Uxbridge, and Taunton stores.As store hours vary by location, customers are encouraged to check their local store's website.Is Wegmans open on Easter 2026?Wegmans – including the locations in Chestnut Hill, Medford, and Burlington – will be open normal business hours on Easter Sunday, according to a company spokesperson.Certain departments may have modified or shortened hours, so customers should contact their local store for more information, Wegmans said.Is Whole Foods open on Easter 2026?Many Whole Foods locations are open on Easter Sunday, but with modified hours, the chain's website said.Boston's Ink Block and Charles River Plaza locations will be open from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Sunday, April 5. The Shrewsbury, Hingham, Beverly, and Framingham locations will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.Customers should check their local store's website for details.Is Trader Joe's open on Easter 2026?All Trader Joe's stores, including the Boston Seaport, Newton, and Brookline locations, will be open regular hours on Easter 2026.Is Walmart open on Easter 2026?Walmart stores will be open regular hours on Easter Sunday, according to the company. This includes the Brockton, Fall River, Salem, Worcester, and Quincy locations.Is Target open on Easter 2026?All Target stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, according to the company's website.Is Costco open on Easter 2026?All Costco warehouses in Massachusetts will be closed on Easter 2026, according to the company.This includes the Avon, Danvers, Dedham, Everett, Sharon, Waltham, and West Springfield locations.Is BJ's Wholesale Club open on Easter 2026?Most BJ's Wholesale Club locations will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter Sunday, according to the company. However, customers should check with their local club to confirm hours.Is Price Chopper/Market32 open on Easter 2026?Most Price Chopper and Market 32 stores will be open normal hours on Easter Sunday, the company said.
